service.description: What a database made before People P27 needs for payroll to post and stay confidential, run on every seed load (data/ZaaGlAccountsUpdateData.xml) and with nothing to do once done or on a new database (its install data has the mappings): for DefaultSettings and each organization with its own payment mappings, PtPayrollPayment's payable mappings (applied: the organization's InvoicePayroll payable account; unapplied: its PtInvoicePayment unapplied account), and for each with its own InvoicePayroll payable type, the receivable side (InvoicePayroll from the organization, a receivable from a person who left: its InvoiceSales receivable account), each added only where missing, never changing one that is there; and the payments of PtPayrollPayment made before the payrollOrigin mark, with their transactions, marked. Each organization on its own: one that fails is logged and counted, and the rest go on.

actions.script: const out = ec.resource.script('component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/account/PayrollOrigin.js').migrate() mappingCount = out.mappingCount; markedCount = out.markedCount; failedCount = out.failedCount
